source.title: Dataset for: Accidental self-ignition of hydrogen released from pressurized cylinder (Figures 7-9)

invalidation.reason: The same Zenodo archive and numeric Figure 7 workbook were already opened and recorded in the retained post-access diagnostic before this protocol was written.

eligibility.include_only: public actual-hydrogen pressure-release time series with documented initial state or recoverable source conditions and a pressure-releasing restriction

claim_boundary: This protocol is invalidated because numerical outcomes were accessed before its freeze. The retained Jankuj evidence is descriptive/post-access only and cannot support a prospective component pressure-release validation claim. It does not validate ignition probability, flame, radiation, dispersion, detector placement, station control, ESD, station-to-vehicle behavior or field safety.
